text:
My treatment at the DentArt clinic from May to August 2025 left an extremely negative impression. I went there to get a dental bridge installed but encountered a number of serious problems. The process was drawn out for more than three months, and I was not provided with temporary crowns, despite the doctor's promises, which led to complications.

The installed dental bridge caused severe pain, inflammation, and infection. When I asked to have it removed, Dr. Bojana Petrović prescribed antibiotics and suggested treating a healthy tooth, refusing to remove the bridge. Ultimately, after two months of suffering, I had to seek help at a clinic in Podgorica, where the bridge was filed off. An independent expert confirmed the poor quality of the work: tooth 5 under the crown had secondary decay, the crown on tooth 3 was filed down to the metal, and the clinic's diagnosis turned out to be incorrect.

The staff, including doctors Bojana Petrović and Sanda Stanišić, ignored my complaints and offered no adequate solution. My request for a refund and the return of my old, removed crown went unanswered, despite an official letter with proof of delivery. I was not given a refund; instead, the clinic suggested I take the matter to court. As a result, I was left without a prosthesis, without my money, without my good, removed crown, with additional treatment expenses, and two months of suffering.

I chose the clinic based on good reviews and modern equipment, but it seems the reviews are written by the clinic owners and doctors themselves to attract clients. I strongly advise everyone not to go to this clinic due to their incompetence and lack of responsibility.
It's a pity that I have to give 1 star instead of -100.

(Переведено Google) Этим летом мне пломбировал зуб в клинике «ДентАрт» доктор Боян (пломба — 50, анестезия — 20). Я очень разочарован качеством лечения. Цемент был плохо очищен — я несколько дней сплевывал остатки. Пломбу не выровняли и не откорректировали, и язык потом болел ещё два дня. За такую ​​цену такой уровень лечения неприемлем. Не рекомендую эту клинику.

(Оригинал)
I had a tooth filling done at DentArt this summer by Dr. Boyana (filling — 50, anesthesia — 20). I’m very disappointed with the quality of the treatment. The cement wasn’t cleaned properly — I kept spitting out leftover pieces for several days. The filling wasn’t smoothed or adjusted, and my tongue hurt for two days afterward. For the price I paid, this level of care is unacceptable. I wouldn’t recommend this clinic.
Врачи очень дружелюбные и ассистент тоже очень милая и образованная. Я очень рада, что наконец-то нашла образованного и отзывчивого стоматолога. И большое спасибо, рекомендую всем.🥹🥹🥹
Moram se javno zahvaliti dr.Zorici Popović na izrazito velikoj razini strucnosti i strpljenja. Hvala puno na svemu! Odličan ste tim i predivni ljudi.

Ljubazno osoblje i kvalitetna usluga.
Za svaku preporuku.

I've been coming here for 12 years and have had extensive work done. All the work has been fantastic and great value, there is no way I could have afforded all that in my home country so I am very grateful. The staff are always friendly and professional, so I am surprised to see any negative reviews. I recommend them to all the other sailors in the marina without hesitation.
Thank you so much for all your help. No more pain, no more switching doctors thank you.
Vrlo neprofesionalno, 10 puta pozivani u dva dana da zakažemo, niko se nije udostojio da se javi. Na poruke isto ništa. Sramotno od jedne zdravstvene ustanove.

Ako zubarka ima zadah iz usta onda vam to dovoljno govori koliko zna o higijeni i o tome kako se vodi racuna o zubima.

Ukratko receno, nestrucno, nekulturno i neobrazovano osoblje.

Stay away!

Wow! That’s the best way to describe how satisfied I was after having my 6 front teeth restored . I would like to thank the most wonderful doctor Natalia Samarina ( the Russian lady) for her professionalism.

I always had bad teeth, but after having my son 2,5 years ago they have deteriorated rapidly and I started loosing my enamel , it was literally flaking  away :(

I went to my dentist in the UK and she said the only option was to go for veneers.... but boy they are expensive:(

I found Natalia online since I already booked my holidays in Montenegro, so combining dental work with holidays was very attractive idea.

She gave me initial quote based on the pictures and said she can do a cosmetic restoration instead of veneers and I went for it .

I’ve gained my confidence back, I can smile widely now, you really made the difference Natalia !

Thank you so much and hope to see you again next year :)

Regards
Anita
Place to go for perfect smile! :-)
Divni su... kvalitet na nivou😊 Sve pohvale...

Positively surprised with the visit.
My wife needed an urgent appointment related to her pregnancy. Even though the reception desk wasn't speaking English, with the help of Google translate we managed to explain the issue.

After waiting 30 min we met Dr. Damir, who was professional, carrying and spoke fluent English!

Highly recommend the clinic!

Doktor Stojanović je vrhunski dijagnostičar, čije mišljenje nikada nije pobijeno od strane bilo koje institucije, čak ni u velikim medicinskim centrima kao što je Beograd. Sve preporuke za odlazak kod ovog izuzetnog stručnjaka.
Fast service, professional, and the staff is very polite and helpful.

Sigurno jedino mjesto na cijelom sjeveru Crne Gore, a mozda i šire, koje se može pohvaliti najsavremenijom dijagnostičkom aparaturom i izuzetno stručnim kadrom na jednom mjestu. Svaka čast sve pohvale!
